name: Ticket
desc: Used to purchase exclusive items and game-passes. Obtained by random gathering, found on the map, and from mobs.

name: Wind Essence
desc: Used to craft variable white hive equipment and other things. Obtained from gathering and mobs.

name: Fire Essence
desc: Used to craft variable red hive equipment and other things. Obtained from gathering and mobs.

name: Water Essence
desc: Used to craft variable blue hive equipment and other things. Obtained from gathering and mobs.

name: Basic Egg
desc: Always turns into a common bee. Only obtained from the Basic Egg Dispenser.

name: Silver Egg
desc: Always turns into a rare or epic bee. Obtained from quests or the Ticket Shop.

name: Gold Egg
desc: Always turns into an epic or legendary bee. Obtained from quests or the Ticket Shop.

name: Diamond Egg
desc: Always turns into a legendary bee. Obtained from quests or the Ticket Shop.

name: Royal Jelly
desc: Always turns into a random bee. Obtained from mobs, found on the map, or bought in the Royal Jelly Dispenser.

name: Starflower
desc: Creates a Basic Starflower on the field that lasts 3 minutes. Obtained by crafting.

name: Rare Starflower
desc: Creates a Rare Starflower on the field that lasts 4 minutes. Obtained by crafting.

name: Epic Starflower
desc: Creates an Epic Starflower on the field that lasts 5 minutes. Obtained by crafting.

name: Legendary Starflower
desc: Creates a Legendary Starflower on the field that lasts 7 minutes. Obtained by crafting.

name: Mythic Starflower
desc: Creates a Mythic Starflower on the field that lasts 8 minutes. Obtained by crafting.

name: Treat
desc: Feeding to a bee gives it 20 XP. Obtained from mobs, dispensers, random gathering, or crafting.

name: Blueberry
desc: Feeding to a bee gives it 50 XP. Obtained from mobs, dispensers, and random gathering.

name: Strawberry
desc: Feeding to a bee gives it 50 XP. Obtained from mobs, dispensers, and random gathering.

name: Seed
desc: Feeding to a bee gives it 50 XP. Obtained from mobs, dispensers, and random gathering.

name: Pine Cone
desc: Feeding to a bee gives it 50 XP. Obtained from mobs, dispensers, and random gathering.

name: Bamboo
desc: Feeding to a bee gives it 150 XP. Obtained from mobs, dispensers, and random gathering.

name: Exp Orb
desc: Feeding to a bee gives it 100 XP. Obtained from Artist Bear.

name: Bee Net
desc: Use this item to catch bees into your inventory. Obtained from random gathering.

name: Converter
desc: Converts all your pollen into honey. Obtained by crafting.

name: Bamboo Flask
desc: Grants ×1.1 Honey Bonus and ×1.5 Convert Rate. Obtained by crafting.

name: Cone Extract
desc: Grants ×1.5 White Pollen for 30 minutes. Obtained by crafting.

name: Strawberry Extract
desc: Grants ×1.5 Red Pollen for 30 minutes. Obtained by crafting.

name: Blueberry Extract
desc: Grants ×1.5 Blue Pollen for 30 minutes. Obtained by crafting.

name: Seed Oil
desc: Grants ×1.25 Move Speed for 30 minutes. Obtained by crafting.

name: Hydrant Installer
desc: Used to place hydrants in the field. Obtained from buying any Hydrant in the Hydrant Shop.

name: Fire Planter
desc: Places a Fire Planter in the field. Obtained by crafting.

name: Ice Planter
desc: Places an Ice Planter in the field. Obtained by crafting.
